content_zh:
她冷笑一声, 嗤笑道：
“封陵游, 你凭什么认为你有这个魅力, 坐享齐人之福？”
心思被戳破, 封陵游尴尬道：“苏檀，你知道我不是那个意思，但是现在离婚, 你肯定要净身出户的，你看你一个学生，也没有经济来源, 除了这里, 你能去哪？而薇薇，也跟了我很多年, 我不可能抛弃她, 我想, 事情总有解决的办法不是？”
苏檀忍不住给他鼓鼓掌, 笑出了声：
“谢谢你到这个时候了还为我着想, 也谢谢你已经想好了离婚会叫我净身出户。”
封陵游干笑：“我不是那个意思, 苏檀，难不成你想离婚？你之前不是一直不想离的吗？”
苏檀没做声，原身确实是不想离婚的, 她这样改变原身的意愿, 和封陵游离婚，哪天原身要是回来了，会不会不满她这样的决定？只是，苏檀真的觉得，这种没有尊严的生活，真的没有持续下去的必要。
“算了吧，封陵游。”苏檀笑容很淡：“封陵游，我虽然是女人，但也是有尊严的，而我在这个家里的尊严，是由我的丈夫给我的，可你，你把我的尊严踩在脚底下，狠狠碾碎，你凭什么认为，我会和别的女人公用一根黄瓜？说实话，我嫌脏！”
封陵游的表情精彩极了，被苏檀这样一说，他恼羞成怒道：
“苏檀，别给脸不要脸，像你这样一无所有的人，凭什么跟我谈尊严！”
苏檀看了他一眼，只觉得没意思，这个男人，心思全部写在脸上，脑子里像塞了棉花一样，所作所为都让她觉得没意思。
同样是封家的男人，封陵游和封京墨这个叔叔一点都不像。
他要是有封京墨的城府，也不会把事情处理成这样。
苏檀摆摆手，往回走。
封陵游在背后喊：“苏檀，你会后悔的！等离了婚，你会一无所有！”
苏檀脚步顿住，笑得有点涩：“我已经一无所有了，不是吗？”
她这话说得有点轻，封陵游愣了一下，怀疑自己是不是听错了。
白薇走过来，拉了拉他，“陵游，怎么了？”
封陵游一愣，这才意识到自己站在原地，出神很久。
“没事。”

“你和她摊牌了么？陵游，我是真的想给你生孩子，叔叔阿姨也很想抱孙子，可我不想我的孩子一出生就受人鄙视。”
封陵游心有点乱，只敷衍地点头：“我知道了。”
苏檀不知道白薇是几点走的，她一直躲在屋里制作祛痘药膏，半夜她去楼下倒杯水喝，刚走到楼梯口，就听到二楼书房里轰的一声，苏檀皱眉推开门，却见一个香炉被推倒在地，封京墨正趴在桌子上，肩膀抽动。
“你没事吧？”
封京墨没做声，苏檀走近了一些，发现虽然屋里开着空调，但封京墨的衣服全湿了，而他肩膀抖动，青筋爆出，看起来很不好，商陆站在一旁，手里握着电话，一脸紧张。
“封总，我这就打电话给医生过来。”
苏檀扫了封京墨一眼，疑惑道：“他怎么了？”
封京墨牙关紧咬，疼成这样了，硬是一声不吭，倒是个硬骨头。
指望他开口是不可能的，苏檀闻了下香炉的香，檀香，加了点合欢皮和远志，而这两种中药的主要作用就是安神催眠，她当下蹙眉问：“是不是神经痛？”
商陆早听说苏檀治好了陈家华的老婆，当下点头急道：
“是！封总这是老毛病了，但以前一直是中午犯病，这还是第一次晚上发作。”
“中午？”苏檀飞快地抬起他的手腕，为他把脉，很快，她折回屋里，拿了药包来。
“躺下！”
封京墨躺在椅子上，苏檀拔出针，准确地扎在鱼腰穴、四白穴、颊车穴等穴位上，再配以阿是、凤池、合谷穴位，在这些穴位插满针，一时间，只见封京墨的脸上到处是细针，可他依旧紧闭双目，自始至终没有睁开。
苏檀轻轻转动阿是穴上的针，随着她的转动，封京墨的神色舒缓不少，苏檀心知这是自己的针灸起了作用。
她又为他针灸了其他穴位，半个小时后，封京墨猛地睁开眼。
商陆在一旁着急道：“封总，你怎么样了？好点了吗？实在不行，我把医生给请来吧？”
封京墨因为这个毛病吃了不少苦头，这些年一直有固定的医生治疗，只是他第一次晚上犯病，医生离这里很远，商陆没来得及叫他过来。

content_en:
She sneered and said with a sneer:
"Feng Lingyou, why do you think you have this charm and can enjoy the blessings of others?"
His mind was exposed, Feng Lingyou said awkwardly: "Su Tan, you know I didn't mean that, but now that you are divorced, you will definitely have to clean up and leave the house. You see, you are a student and have no financial resources. Where can you go except here? And Weiwei has been with me for many years. I can't abandon her. I think there is always a way to solve things, right?"
Su Tan couldn't help but applaud him and laughed out loud:
"Thank you for still thinking about me at this time, and thank you for having already thought about asking me to leave the house after divorce."
Feng Lingyou smiled dryly: "That's not what I meant. Su Tan, could it be that you want a divorce? Haven't you always wanted to divorce before?"
Su Tan remained silent. The original person really did not want a divorce. She changed her original intention and divorced Fenglingyou. If the original person came back one day, would she be dissatisfied with her decision? However, Su Tan really felt that there was really no need to continue this kind of life without dignity.
"Forget it, Fenglingyou." Su Tan smiled lightly: "Fenglingyou, although I am a woman, I still have dignity, and my dignity in this family was given to me by my husband. But you, you stepped on my dignity under your feet and crushed it hard. Why do you think I would share a cucumber with another woman? To be honest, I feel dirty!"
Fenglingyou's expression was extremely wonderful. When Su Tan said this, he became angry and said:
"Su Tan, don't be so shameless. A person like you who has nothing, why should you talk to me about dignity?"
Su Tan glanced at him and found him boring. This man's thoughts were all written on his face, and his mind was stuffed with cotton. Everything he did made her feel boring.
Also a man from the Feng family, Feng Lingyou looked nothing like his uncle Feng Jingmo.
If he had the capital of Feng Jingmo, he would not handle the matter like this.
Su Tan waved his hand and walked back.
Feng Lingyou shouted from behind: "Su Tan, you will regret it! Once divorced, you will have nothing!"
Su Tan paused and smiled a little bitterly: "I have nothing, don't I?"
She said it a bit softly, and Fenglingyou was stunned for a moment, wondering if he heard it wrong.
Bai Wei came over and pulled him, "Lingyou, what's wrong?"
Fenglingyou was stunned for a moment, and then he realized that he was standing there, lost in thought for a long time.
"It's okay."
"Have you had a showdown with her? Lingyou, I really want to give you a child. My uncle and aunt also want to have grandchildren, but I don't want my child to be despised as soon as he is born."
Fengling You was a little confused and just nodded perfunctorily: "I understand."
Su Tan didn't know what time Bai Wei left. She had been hiding in the house making anti-acne ointment. In the middle of the night, she went downstairs to get a glass of water. As soon as she reached the stairs, she heard a bang in the study on the second floor. Su Tan frowned and pushed the door open, only to see an incense burner pushed to the ground. Feng Jingmo was lying on the table, his shoulders twitching.
"Are you okay?"
Feng Jingmo remained silent. Su Tan came closer and found that although the air conditioner was on in the room, Feng Jingmo's clothes were all wet. His shoulders were shaking and his veins were popping out. He looked very bad. Shanglu stood aside, holding a phone in his hand, with a nervous look on his face.
"Mr. Feng, I'll call the doctor right away."
Su Tan glanced at Feng Jingmo and asked doubtfully, "What's wrong with him?"
Feng Jingmo clenched his teeth. It was so painful that he kept silent. He was a tough guy.
It was impossible to expect him to speak. Su Tan smelled the incense from the incense burner, sandalwood, and added some albizia bark and polygala. The main functions of these two traditional Chinese medicines are to calm the mind and hypnotize. She frowned and asked, "Is it neuralgia?"
Shang Lu had long heard that Su Tan had cured Chen Jiahua's wife, and immediately nodded and said anxiously:
"Yes! Mr. Feng, this is an old problem., but I have always gotten sick at noon before, but this is the first time I have had an attack at night. "
"noon? "Su Tan quickly raised his wrist and checked his pulse. Soon, she went back to the room and got the medicine bag.
"Lie down! "
Feng Jingmo was lying on the chair. Su Tan pulled out the needles and accurately inserted them into the Yuyao, Sibai, Jieche and other acupoints, as well as the Ashi, Fengchi, and Hegu acupoints. These acupuncture points were filled with needles. For a moment, Feng Jingmo's face was covered with fine needles, but he still closed his eyes tightly and did not open them from the beginning to the end.
Su Tan gently turned the needle on Ah Shi's acupoint. As she turned, Feng Jingmo's expression relaxed a lot. Su Tan knew that this was because her acupuncture had worked.
She acupunctured other acupuncture points for him. Half an hour later, Feng Jingmo opened his eyes suddenly.
Shang Lu said anxiously: "Mr. Feng, how are you? Feeling better? If it doesn't work, can I invite the doctor? "
Feng Jingmo suffered a lot because of this problem. He has been treated by a regular doctor over the years, but this was the first time he fell ill at night. The doctor was far away from here and Phytolacca did not have time to call him over.
